zone.title: Zone with two heat sources

zone_master.title: Zone with two heat sources: master thermostat
zone_master.description:
A zone heated by two thermostats with SmartPI (for example a radiator and an underfloor loop) is set up from its master thermostat: a Versatile Thermostat over climate whose two devices are these thermostats. The master holds the setpoint, presets, schedule, mode and windows of the zone and passes them to both.

The master must have self-regulation off and exactly two devices, both Versatile Thermostats with SmartPI, measuring the zone with the same temperature sensor, and neither may already belong to another zone. Recommended on the master: a long safety delay (its safety mode switches both devices off) and a small regulation threshold step.

zone_sources.title: Zone with two heat sources: sources and split

data.custom_response: Set the additional source's delay and lag

data_description.main_source: The source that corrects quickly; usually the faster one.
data_description.custom_response: Otherwise its heating type gives the starting values, which the zone then learns. The main source's delay is learned by the zone.

zone_parameter.title: Zone with two heat sources: rule parameter

data.split_ratio: Additional source's command (% of the main source's)

zone_reset.title: Reset the zone's learned model
zone_reset.description: This change affects what the zone has learned: a source added, removed or swapped, the main source changed, or the additional source's custom response changed. Resetting clears SmartPI's whole learned model of the main source (its a, b, dead times and the zone's fit) so that it learns again from the start; it is recommended.

source_role.title: Additional source of a zone
source_role.description: This thermostat works as the additional source of the zone set up in {main}: it applies the commands of that zone's main source, and its own regulation and learning are paused. The zone's settings are in that entry. Here are the settings that still apply: its cycle's delays, its heating type and, for a valve, its curve. Its other regulator settings keep their values and apply only when it regulates on its own because the main source has gone silent.

model_reset.title: Reset the zone's learned model
model_reset.description: This change affects what the zone has learned: a neighbour added or removed, or its connection changed. Resetting clears SmartPI's whole learned model of this thermostat so that it learns again from the start; it is recommended.

confirm.title: Reset the learned model of {name}?
confirm.description: SmartPI now receives the supply water temperature for this thermostat from Smart Boiler, so its heating power is measured at a reference water temperature. The power learned before does not match these units. Resetting lets SmartPI learn the room again (recommended).

confirm.description: Smart Boiler reports that the supply water temperature of this thermostat's circuit is no longer measured, so SmartPI works without it. The power learned at a reference water temperature does not match these units. Resetting lets SmartPI learn the room again (recommended).
